prompt: Here's the current Automatic Persisted Queries setup for our GraphQL API. We run 4 identical Apollo Server replicas behind a round-robin load balancer, and even with APQ turned on, monitoring shows request payloads never shrink down to hash-size — we're seeing roughly a 75% PERSISTED_QUERY_NOT_FOUND rate that spikes to near-100% right after every deploy or rolling restart before slowly settling back down. Walk me through why this topology can't deliver the win APQ is supposed to buy, and tell me how you'd change the setup so the persisted-query registry actually works across all four replicas and survives restarts.
